tools.name: prepare_pickleball_browse
tools.description: Offer courts to play at, clubs to join, or open play sessions for a named city, state or country. Returns a spoken reply and structured choices for UI or voice agents; does not search live availability or join/book anything.

tools.name: search_pickleball_rules
tools.description: Search the validated USA Pickleball rulebook. Returns English evidence, edition and rule citations, plus a grounded answer when the private resolver is enabled. Preserve requests for clarification; excerpts alone do not establish a complete ruling. No package download.

tools.name: search_myopl_help
tools.description: Find published MYOPL Help Center instructions with source URLs. No account or conversation access.

tools.name: search_myopl_website
tools.description: Find published MYOPL product and website information with source URLs. No account or conversation access.

tools.name: get_public_player_rating
tools.description: Look up an exact public username and published OPL ratings. No email, telephone, location, match history or private profile fields.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_myopl_help, search_myopl_website, get_public_player_rating · Private data: search_pickleball_rules, get_public_player_rating · Public sink: get_public_player_rating.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_myopl_help, search_myopl_website, get_public_player_rating · Private data: search_pickleball_rules, get_public_player_rating · Public sink: get_public_player_rating

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
